categories.name: build
categories.evidence: Touches contrib/guix/manifest_codesign.scm and carries the Build system label.
categories.rationale: Fixes a build failure in the Guix macOS codesigning environment on systems using Python 3.12. As noted in commit 82a8c8009a, setuptools is missing and certvalidator imports the removed imp module, 'preventing the macOS codesigning environment from building.'

categories.name: tools
categories.evidence: The tools category explicitly excludes build and release scripts, which belong in build.
categories.rationale: Does not belong to tools; Guix packaging manifests fall under build and release tooling.
